snippet.title: MyDear.exe - An interactive love letter Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
MyDear.exe is a tiny game in which you will discover the lives of two adorable elderly people, Eli, the artist and photographer, and Lucien, the postman who became a computer engineer after discovering his passion for bips and boops.

Play as Eli and spend around 2 hours exploring the game that Lucien developed for her in the old family computer! Souvenir photos, sweet notes, mini-games... use everything you find to solve the puzzles Lucien has prepared.

STEAM : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4255640/MyDearexe/
